title: [Accommodation Request API - POST /api/traveler/request-bids] Negative roomCount (-1) Bypasses INVALID_ROOM_OR_GUEST_COUNT Validation and Persists Open Request (HTTP 200 OK)
environment: Staging (STAG) · Strapi Backend API & Desktop 1440×900 · Chrome · en-US · FE=turbopack-2h-u0he6dowwt, BE=<CHECK_DEPLOYED_SHA> (https://web.stag.goodnstay.com/en-US/accommodation)
test_account: Signed-In QA Traveler Session on Staging (Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED_QA_TOKEN>)
steps_to_reproduce: Prepare the complete valid room-request fixture (fixtures/valid-request-bids.json) using sanitized QA data (QA Tester, qa-sample@example.test, +84900000000, KR / KR-11, guestCount=2, roomCount=1).
Verify the endpoint's boundary rule baseline by setting ONLY data.roomCount=0 -> returns HTTP 400 INVALID_ROOM_OR_GUEST_COUNT ('Room count and guest count must be greater than 0.').
Single-Variable Mutation: Clone fixtures/valid-request-bids.json and change ONLY data.roomCount from 1 to -1 (fixtures/request-bids-negative-room-count.json).
Execute GET https://services.stag.goodnstay.com/api/customer-requests readback to check whether a negative-room Customer Request was saved (then cancel the test record).
actual_result:
- POST /api/traveler/request-bids with data.roomCount = -1 returns HTTP 200 OK ({"success": true, "message": "Rating created successfully."}).
- GET /api/customer-requests readback confirms open Customer Request #1534 was persisted in PostgreSQL with roomCount = -1.
expected_result:
- Per the endpoint's own boundary rule ('Room count and guest count must be greater than 0.'), POST /api/traveler/request-bids must reject any data.roomCount < 1 (including negative integers) with HTTP 400 Bad Request and error code INVALID_ROOM_OR_GUEST_COUNT.
- Zero Customer Request records may be created in the database.

evidence.console: Test Case STAG-API-005 | Single-Variable Delta: data.roomCount (1 -> -1) | Test record #1534 cancelled immediately after readback.
evidence.network: POST https://services.stag.goodnstay.com/api/traveler/request-bids (data.roomCount=-1) -> HTTP 200 OK; GET /api/customer-requests -> HTTP 200 OK confirming id=1534 persisted with roomCount=-1.
evidence.notes: Frontend chunk 452btq2-mvhin.js calls POST /api/traveler/request-bids. Backend checks !roomCount / roomCount === 0 instead of roomCount < 1. (Note for BE owner: response serializer on this controller also returns unredacted up_users.[REDACTED] columns and message 'Rating created successfully.'). | Security Classification: OWASP A06:2025 Insecure Design (CWE-840) & OWASP A04:2025 Cryptographic Failures / A01:2025 (CWE-201) · OWASP API3:2023 BOPLA (Excessive Data Exposure) | OWASP Remediation: Enforce server-side roomCount >= 1 domain invariant and strict DTO response allow-listing (https://cheatsheetseries.owasp.org/cheatsheets/REST_Security_Cheat_Sheet.html).

classification: Confirmed Bug — Negative roomCount (-1) Bypasses INVALID_ROOM_OR_GUEST_COUNT Boundary Guard on POST /api/traveler/request-bids
reproducibility: Always (100% — single-variable mutation verified with GET readback on STAG)
